title: Speaking — Helping out
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on helping out.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
Do you often help people with everyday tasks?
What small favour do you appreciate receiving?

part2.topic: Describe a time when your help made a practical difference.
part2.closing: and explain what you learned about offering help.

questions: Why do people sometimes hesitate to accept help from others?
How can organisations support volunteers who cannot commit to regular hours?
How has everyday life connected with helping out changed for people of different ages?
